lines: Asuka hurriedly stopped Lena, who readied her sword without hesitation.
「Wait! If we fight her for real here, it'll invite more and more misunderstandings. Let's take the easy route and run away for now.」
「What? Run away? Are you telling a Hell Knight to show her back to the enemy?!」
「I mean, she's not our enemy, right?! Even if you're a demon, and your opponent's a Taimanin, you don't want to kill each other over a misunderstanding, do you? I don't.」
「Knights don't do senseless things, right? I also want to ask you about this memory card, so at this point, it's a case of “Running away is a strategy too.”」
When she rattled all that off, even the hasty Hell Knight Lena became lost in thought for a moment.
「Mmm, certainly, you do have a point...」
Then, looking convinced, she turned the blade of Sakura Blossom around.
「I don't like striking with the back of my sword, but...」
「What you like or don't like is neither here nor there right now!」
「The enemies' nature is unclear. Attack them two at a time!」
On Tomoe's order, four of her subordinates split into two groups and approached.
A wait-and-see approach, huh? As one would expect from Taimanin, it was well-coordinated movement.
Furthermore, right now, Asuka's limbs were her everyday ones. She didn't feel up to having close-quarters combat against Taimanin.
“Sorry, but I'm going to use my Wind Escape from far ahead of your range.”
Asuka dispatched a gust of wind towards the feet of two of them, sharply, but looking as though she were holding back her power.
Having their feet swept magnificently out from under them, the Taimanin fell over in the opposite direction.
And then, they crashed into the wall hard enough for them to pass out.
The two of them had fainted together.
Since her opponents were women, she apologized briefly.
As for Lena, she was being slashed at by the other two, but she was evading that with light steps, and
Swiftly striking her opponents with the back of Sakura Blossom.
The Taimanin grimaced, but it wasn't enough to knock them out.
「Was that still a little too weak? Hi-yaaah!」
They finally collapsed on the spot, alongside each other.
That was a Hell Knight for you. It looked like she wasn't used to holding back against Taimanin.
（Still, it looks like they'll be fine. I'm concerned about that hardheaded one, though......）
As for that hardheaded one, she alone had still not drawn her sword as she intently watched the way they fought.
Or rather, she had an air to her which seemed like she was going to pull something major without any warning.
「You guys pull back. It looks like these are no ordinary people.」
Despite making a suspicious expression, seeing the pair's strength, she was nevertheless drawing back her subordinates.
「At this point, it looks like there's no other choice but for me to take you on. Enter Kuroda Tomoe!」
Her right hand, which was placed on the hilt of her sword, moved in a flash.
Tomoe had drawn her sword like a gust of wind, without even moving a step from that spot.
Asuka and Lena jumped far back at almost the same time due to her strong murderous air.
When Tomoe sheathed her sword again, a lock of Lena's hair gently fluttered down.
「I thought so. A quick-draw slash attack, huh?」
「Evaded the first strike of my longsword, did you? That's what you get with a Hell Knight from Nomad, I suppose.」
「It's impossible to reason with her, isn't it?」
「Very well. Next, it's my turn to show you the sharpness of my Sakura Blossom!」
Lena returned the blade of Sakura Blossom, which she had reversed in order to strike with the back of her sword, to its original orientation.
She was furious about her hair being cut, even if it was only a little.
Asuka sympathized. If hers had been damaged, she would have been angry too.
「Wind user. Stand back. Taimanin, this is a one-on-one battle!」
「I could ask for nothing better, Hell Knight!」
The two of them were just about to enter into a duel.
（Whoa, this is baaad... I've got to do something to stop them. I don't want to fight with a Taimanin either...）
But, how to stop a fight between two master swordswomen......?
No sooner had she suddenly heard a voice in her ear than
Smoke began to rise from all around.
Unlike that of the fire, which was still ongoing, this was a smokescreen, wherein a thick, pure-white smoke spread out.
She couldn't see them, but there was someone there.
They were moving around all over the place.
They were using the fainted Taimanin's smoke bombs one after another.
In an instant, everyone became unable to see anything around them at all.
It was no time for a one-on-one battle.
Only that voice was heard again.
She couldn't see his figure. This was―――
It was the pickup artist from before.
She didn't understand it, but this was their chance.
Asuka grabbed the arm of Lena, who was looking around amid the smoke.
「What?! What about me duelling that girl?!」
「This is one of those “Running away is a strategy” times!!」
They were going to retreat, no arguments allowed.
They could hear Tomoe shouting, on the other side of the smoke, where they could no longer see anything.
